# wallix-bastion_device_service (Data Source)

Get information on a service resource linked to a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific device service
data "wallix-bastion_device_service" "ssh" {
  device_id    = wallix-bastion_device.server1.id
  service_name = "SSH"
}

# Reuse the service's connection policy when creating an authorization
resource "wallix-bastion_authorization" "ssh_access" {
  authorization_name = "ssh-access"
  target_group       = wallix-bastion_targetgroup.servers.group_name
  user_group         = wallix-bastion_usergroup.admins.group_name
  authorized_targets = [
    data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.connection_policy,
  ]
}

# Output service configuration
output "ssh_service_info" {
  value = {
    id                = data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.id
    connection_policy = data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.connection_policy
    port              = data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.port
    protocol          = data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.protocol
    subprotocols      = data.wallix-bastion_device_service.ssh.subprotocols
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String)
- `service_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connection_policy` (String)
- `global_domains` (Set of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
- `subprotocols` (Set of String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

This data source requires both `device_id` and `service_name` to locate the service:

- **device_id**: The internal ID of the parent device
- **service_name**: The name of the service configured on that device

### Attributes

- **connection_policy**: The connection policy applied to sessions using this service
- **port** / **protocol**: The network port and protocol used to reach the device
- **subprotocols**: The set of subprotocols enabled for the service (e.g. `SSH_SHELL_SESSION`, `RDP_DRIVE`)
- **global_domains**: Global domains permitted to authenticate against this service; empty when not restricted

### Prerequisites

The referenced device must already exist (`wallix-bastion_device`), and the service must have been created on it (`wallix-bastion_device_service`) before it can be looked up.
